calibrationSampling.policy: Before comparing templates, take the first frozen-order positive and first explicit abstention case for each of title/image/description. Selection uses field and ground-truth class only, never predictions. Full holdout retained.
calibrationSampling.reason: Initial sequential browser WASM timing pilot exceeded the evaluation time budget; full 30-case calibration replaced with predeclared six-case strata.
